dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Matlow Mint, an all ebony kitty was left without a word in a carrier, in front of a police precinct. He was calm upon arrival at the care center but became fearful the moment he was placed in a kennel. It took him days, even weeks to fall back on his four, come out of his cubby, seek company, play and petting. Matlow Mint is now most often seen on his "balcony", trying to get someone's attention, may be some treats and a chance to observe his ward through an open door. He seems to enjoy petting without being overstimulated and is very taken by all what is going on around him. Sadly, he can not come out after all this time spent in a kennel...But you can change that, make a huge difference in Matlow Mint's life by adopting him, giving him a home and a loving family. Matlow Mint is waiting for you at the Manhattan Care Center!
dog.name: Matlow Mint
